gutter_detection.note: Coordinates are logical authored modules from the real 14x14 source sheet, not 32px crops from the previously mis-normalized 16x16 runtime atlas.

runtime_atlas.mapping_rule: Logical source coord [x,y] maps to identical runtime coord [x,y] after per-module repack. Never resize the full 1254x1254 sheet as one image.

runtime_contract.unit_rule: Every promoted wall module is a native 32x32 runtime cell. Do not stretch modules to create height.
runtime_contract.composition_rule: Broad horizontal structural mass/roof surface is owned by the floor/roof surface layer. This wall atlas owns exposed caps, faces, openings, rails, transitions, damage, and channel boundaries.
runtime_contract.topology_first: Choose geometry/topology class first, then choose a style variant within a compatible family. Never randomly select across corners, straights, terminals, openings, slopes, and damage.
runtime_contract.orientation_rule: Do not runtime-rotate or mirror these sprites. Lighting and asymmetric details are authored. Exact directional ports for review_required topology pieces must be reviewed before automatic neighbor-mask selection.
runtime_contract.facade_rule: front_facade/front_edge modules belong on authored exposed player-facing edges, not as tiled interior wall-body fill.
runtime_contract.damage_rule: Damaged/rubble modules are explicit authored beats only and must never be scattered into continuity-critical runs.
runtime_contract.collision_rule: Manifest collision hints are non-authoritative. Authored topology/collision/navigation remain gameplay authority.
runtime_contract.y_sort_rule: These are structural presentation modules, not free-standing native props. Depth/layer is determined by the wall presentation system.
runtime_contract.reserved_rule: Runtime coords with x>=14 or y>=14 are invalid/reserved transparent cells and must fail closed.

wall_cap.description: Masonry cap/topology modules for exposed upper wall edges. Topology must be selected before style.

civic_opening.description: Civic arch, gate, window, niche and portal modules.

utility_parapet.description: Low utility parapet and railing modules.

retaining_wall.description: Stone retaining wall faces, terminals and broken variants.

pipe_retaining.description: Retaining wall modules with pipe/conduit language.

civic_railing.description: Civic railing modules for exposed edges.

service_gate_edge.description: Service gate/edge modules with stronger equipment identity.

grille_retaining.description: Industrial grille retaining modules and terminals.

retaining_transition.description: Slope, stair and retaining transitions. Never infer walkability from the sprite.

rubble_transition.description: Collapsed, rubble and breach transitions. Never use as random decoration in a continuity-critical wall run.

station_facade.description: Station-oriented doors and high-formality facade modules.

damaged_facade.description: Damaged doors, windows, collapsed facade faces and breaches.

canal_edge.description: Water/channel edge, straight, corner and terminal modules. Surface/collision remain separate authorities.

topology_contract.ports_meaning: Ports describe intended structural continuation through the module, not raw nontransparent pixels touching the cell edge.
topology_contract.auto_compose_gate: Only entries with composer.auto_compose=true may be selected by neighbor-mask logic.
topology_contract.manual_rule: Explicit authored doors, windows, gates, slopes, stairs, damage, rubble, terminals, service punctuation and ambiguous diagonal water pieces must never be injected by automatic topology selection.
topology_contract.variant_rule: Automatic selection first resolves an exact port/topology signature, then may choose only among style-compatible entries with that same signature.
topology_contract.rotation_rule: No runtime rotation or mirroring. Use source-authored orientation only.
